title: FrontFamily — Verified Component Conversion Between UI Frameworks
excerpt: Deterministic component conversion between MUI, Chakra UI, Ant Design, EUI, Mantine, Bootstrap, and Quasar. 219 hand-verified mappings. Runs in your browser — no code sent anywhere.
content_html:
FrontFamily

7 frameworks · 42 paths · 219 mappings

Framework migration without the guesswork

219 hand-verified component mappings across 7 UI libraries. Deterministic conversion. No AI, no hallucinated props, no code leaving your browser.

ReactVueAngularSvelteTypeScript

MUI → Chakra UI

Source

<Dialog open={isOpen} onClose={handleClose} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
  <DialogTitle>Delete project</DialogTitle>
  <DialogActions>
    <Button onClick={handleClose}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button color="error" onClick={handleDelete}>Delete</Button>
  </DialogActions>
</Dialog>

Converted

<Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={handleClose} size="sm">
  <ModalOverlay />
  <ModalContent>
    <ModalHeader>Delete project</ModalHeader>
    <ModalFooter>
      <Button onClick={handleClose}>Cancel</Button>
      <Button colorScheme="red" onClick={handleDelete}>Delete</Button>
    </ModalFooter>
  </ModalContent>
</Modal>

Chakra's onClose fires on overlay click — MUI's Dialog doesn't by default. Flagged automatically.

Why not just ask AI?

Deterministic

Same input, same output, every time. Every mapping verified by hand against both libraries' docs.

Private

Runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server. Safe for proprietary code.

Honest

Confidence scores per conversion. When a prop has no equivalent, we say so instead of inventing one.
